stem: Priya starts from point O facing North. She walks 6 km, then turns right and walks 8 km, then turns right again and walks 6 km. How far is she from O, and in which direction?

options.text: 8 km, to the West of O
8 km, to the East of O

per_option_rationale.rationale: After the three legs Priya is at (8, 0) relative to O, which is 8 km due East.
Student added all three distances (6 + 8 + 6 = 20) without tracking direction, giving a scalar total instead of net displacement.
Student turned left at each instruction instead of right, finishing 8 km to the West of O.
Student ignored the last 6 km southward leg and calculated the distance from O to the intermediate point (8, 6), which is sqrt(64 + 36) = 10 km.

explanation: Track coordinates: start at (0, 0) facing North. Walk 6 km North to (0, 6). Turn right (now East), walk 8 km to (8, 6). Turn right (now South), walk 6 km to (8, 0). Distance from O = 8 km, direction East.
